note: Presentation-only metadata for the desktop GUI (tagline, monogram avatar, color). It never decides whether a profile can be loaded: config/voice_profiles.json and the backend's ProfileSummary/EngineStatus are authoritative. Avatars are original monograms; 'avatar' may name a local PNG under gui/assets/ whose usage rights have been verified (none yet).
